about: A November clopidogrel review records a history of GAVE with no diagnosis date, and a later gastroscopy is normal.
Possible finding: the record holds no line about GAVE. Eliquis (apixaban, an anticoagulant) is supplied monthly by brand name only from January to July 2026.
Aspirin (Cartia) is supplied monthly and the review of previous endoscopy and clinical records explicitly excludes past and current GAVE.
